name: com.funciara/mcp
title: Funciara.com
description: Prepare a Romanian land-registry extract order for a person to finish and pay on funciara.com.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Read the current price per document, the delivery term in working days, the counties that take paid orders now and whether the site is reservation-only. Call this first and again whenever you quote a price or term; do not use it to check one property.

tools.name: list_counties
tools.description: List all Romanian counties (and Bucharest) with the ids the other tools accept. Use it to find a county id; to find a locality use search_localities.

tools.name: search_localities
tools.description: Search the localities of one county by name (diacritics ignored), in pages. Use it to get a locality id or confirm a spelling; to prepare an order use create_order_link, which also accepts the name.

county.description: The county: its numeric id as text (from list_counties) or its name, with or without diacritics.

query.description: Part of the locality name. Omit to page through all localities of the county.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: check_property_number
tools.description: Check a property number: returns the normalised value, a refusal code when it certainly is not a property number, and warnings that do not block. County and locality are optional: without them only the format is checked; with them the check adds the local number-range warning and the order mode, price and term. Use it before create_order_link when unsure; it stores nothing and prepares no link.

documentType.description: Catalogue id of the document. EXTRACT_CF (default) is the land-registry extract for information.

county.description: The county: its numeric id as text (from list_counties) or its name, with or without diacritics.

locality.description: The locality: its numeric id as text (from search_localities) or its name, with or without diacritics.

estateIdentifier.description: The property number as the person has it: CF number, cadastral number, topographic number or electronic identifier, for example 40461 or 8014-C1-U5.

cadastralNumber.description: Optional second number, usually the cadastral number, when the person has both.

tools.name: create_order_link
tools.description: Validate a property and prepare an order for the person to finish on funciara.com: returns one link with the form prefilled, plus the mode and, where they apply, the price and delivery term (a reservation has no term). It places no order and takes no payment; give the link to the person. Use dryRun to test without storing anything. Use check_property_number only to test a number without preparing a link.

documentType.description: Catalogue id of the document. EXTRACT_CF (default) is the land-registry extract for information.

county.description: The county: its numeric id as text (from list_counties) or its name, with or without diacritics.

locality.description: The locality: its numeric id as text (from search_localities) or its name, with or without diacritics.

estateIdentifier.description: The property number as the person has it: CF number, cadastral number, topographic number or electronic identifier, for example 40461 or 8014-C1-U5.

cadastralNumber.description: Optional second number, usually the cadastral number, when the person has both.

contact.description: Optional. Only include what the person gave you (name, e-mail, phone, invoice details). Details of the person that only prefill their order form on funciara.com. They are kept for 72 hours and then expire. Privacy policy: https://funciara.com/politica-confidentialitate

dryRun.description: When true, validate and return the same answer but store nothing and return no link. Use it to test.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read the state of an order the person already placed, from its order id and tracking token (both given to the person after ordering). Use it only for an existing order; it cannot find an order without its token. It never returns the document or a download link: it returns the funciara.com tracking page, where the person downloads the document.

orderId.description: The order id or order number the person received.

trackingToken.description: The tracking token the person received with the order.
